reason.transport_unsupported: This bot connects over a method that has no channel for it — it needs {detail}.
reason.missing_oauth_scope: The connector was not granted the access this needs ({detail}).
reason.upstream_impl_unsupported: The server this bot connects to does not implement {detail}.
reason.instance_setting_off: Turned off by this bot's “{detail}” setting.
reason.scene_unsupported: The platform only offers this in: {detail}.
reason.not_declared: This platform does not offer it.

nextStep.transport_unsupported: Switch this bot's connection method to one that carries it.
nextStep.missing_oauth_scope: Re-authorize this bot to add the missing access.
nextStep.upstream_impl_unsupported: Point this bot at a server that implements it, or upgrade the one it uses.
nextStep.instance_setting_off: Turn that setting on to use it.

block.no-runtime: This browser is not paired with anything that runs bots, so there is no connector to configure.
block.runs-on-host: This bot runs on the host you paired with. These controls talk to that runtime directly, and a browser has no route to it — replying, approving drafts and per-conversation settings do reach it, and keep working here.
block.needs-desktop-shell: This one needs the desktop app itself, not just a running bot.

nextStep.no-runtime: Open Cognia on your desktop, or pair this browser with a host that is running one.
nextStep.runs-on-host: Open Cognia on the host running this bot to change it.
nextStep.needs-desktop-shell: Open Cognia on your desktop to use it.
